messages.title: 九境 Ninefold
body: **An idle cultivation game, painted in ink.** Qi gathers on its own, even with the phone closed, and you climb nine realms and the nine heavens above them.
Losing a fight never costs anything, and nothing is ever taken away for being away. Try everything.

messages.title: 規 The rules
body: **1 · Be kind.** This is a small community and everyone here is helping.
**2 · Keep it closed.** The game is in closed test. Ask before sharing it outside the server.
**3 · One bug, one post.** In {#bugs}, so nothing gets lost.
**4 · No spam, no ads,** nothing you would not show a stranger.
**5 · Nobody pings @everyone.** A new build pings 告 New builds, and only the people who asked for it.
Invite links, scam links and mass mentions are held back automatically. The 守 Guardians see every one, and breaking the rules gets a warning, then a timeout.

messages.title: 告 Ninefold · The first closed test
body: Hey everyone. This is the new home for **九境 Ninefold**, the game I have been building since Dao of the Endless Sky closed.

It is an idle cultivation game, painted in ink. You gather qi, climb nine realms of nine layers, and cross the tribulation into nine heavens above the summit. Every beast is painted by hand, every realm has its own landscape, and the people you meet on the road remember what you did.
It is built around one promise: **nothing is ever taken away for being away.** Close it for a week and your cultivator is further along, never behind.
**What I need from you:** play it the way you would if nobody was watching. Then tell me what confused you, what annoyed you, and what made you come back.
messages.footer: Thank you for being here · 師 Bruno

messages.title: 報 How to report a bug
body: Open a new post in {#bugs} and say three things:
**1.** What you did.
**2.** What you expected to happen.
**3.** What happened instead.
Add a screenshot and the **Build** line from the bottom of the ≡ menu (top right corner). If the game showed an error, copy its text too.
